description: A small neutral workspace for the Auto routing cases: each entry is one chunk of a document.

chunks.text: Project Nebula budget. The steering board approved a budget of 480,000 EUR for Project Nebula in March. Hardware takes 120,000 EUR, staff costs take 300,000 EUR and the remaining 60,000 EUR are a reserve.
Budget reviews take place every quarter. The finance team reports spending against the approved budget to the steering board and proposes changes when a line is exceeded by more than ten percent.
Remote work policy. Staff may work remotely on up to two days per week after approval by their team lead. Core hours are from 10:00 to 15:00 on every working day.
Equipment for remote work: the company provides a laptop and a headset. A second monitor can be requested through the service desk; furniture is not reimbursed.
Travel expenses. Train journeys over four hours may be booked in first class. Hotel stays are reimbursed for up to five nights per trip; receipts must be submitted within thirty days.
The canteen opens at 08:00 and serves lunch from 11:30 to 14:00. A vegetarian dish is offered every day; on Fridays there is a fish menu.
Onboarding checklist for new colleagues: collect the badge at reception, set up the laptop with the service desk, complete the security training in the first week and meet the mentor.
Release notes version 2.3: the export dialog now supports CSV and JSON, search results load faster, and a bug that duplicated calendar entries was fixed.
Urlaubsregelung. Alle Beschäftigten haben Anspruch auf 30 Urlaubstage im Jahr. Resturlaub muss bis zum 31. März des Folgejahres genommen werden.
Urlaubsanträge werden im Personalportal gestellt und von der Teamleitung innerhalb von fünf Arbeitstagen genehmigt oder abgelehnt.
